app.ContextDBMS.note: Managed singleton: the persistent context database. Holds every collectible's save-wide state. See beetleContextChain.

app.Gm82_009.note: The runtime component for a Golden Trove Beetle (a glowing gatherable; Gm82_080 is the almanac's data-group id). NOT used for collected-state — a collected beetle doesn't respawn a gimmick, so its state comes from the ContextDB (see beetleContextChain). Kept for reference.

app.GatherContext.note: Not a singleton. The per-collectible gather record inside a ContextDatabaseRecord. The reader resolves its managed_vt live from TDB types[typeIndex]+0x40 to pick it out of a record's Contexts list. Collected iff byte +0x28 == 0. See beetleContextChain.

cameraChain.note: Main render camera, structurally: CameraManager instance +0x10 (_CameraObjects, fixed array) +0x20 ([0] GameObject) +0x18 (Transform). Transform+0x80 = worldTransform 4x4 (rows right/up/fwd, row3 = CELL-LOCAL pos - use the global camera chain for position). Transform+0x18 (childComponent) = RECamera: near +0x30, far +0x34, fov +0x38, lookAtDistance +0x3c, aspect +0x44. Layouts from REFramework ReClass_Internal_DD2.hpp (MIT).

neverGenerateChain.note: app.GenerateManager._NeverGenetateID: every collectible GUID (tokens AND beetles/chests/etc — not tokens-only) the game will never spawn again. GenerateManager instance +0x10+0x1f0 = the field's live pointer, a HashSet`1<System.Guid> whose own field layout is a verbatim match for real .NET's HashSet<T> (found live via tools/singletonHunt.js --deref). HashSet +0x10+0x08 = _slots array ptr, +0x10+0x20 = _count (i32). _slots array object +0x20 = Slot[0]; each Slot is 16 bytes {hashCode:i32 @0, next:i32 @4, valuePtr:i64 @8} — valuePtr is a BOXED Guid (the VM boxes generic value-type args), so valuePtr+0x10 is the 16 raw Guid bytes, decoded with .NET's own byte order (Data1/2/3 little-endian, Data4 raw). See src/main/generateManagerReader.js.

beetleContextChain.note: Golden Trove Beetle collected-state, PERSISTENT and global (near or far, survives reload) — the beetle equivalent of tokens' _NeverGenetateID, and what gibbed's gibbed_Almanac.lua uses. A live-gimmick approach was tried first and abandoned: a COLLECTED beetle does not respawn a gimmick at all, so there's no object to read — collected-state has to come from the save-wide ContextDB. The out-of-process walk mirrors the mod's managed calls: ContextDBMS instance +0x10+0x08 = OfflineDB (== CurrentDB in single-player, a ContextDatabase). ContextDatabase +0x10+0x18 = IndexCreator (app.TowerContextDatabaseIndexCreator). IndexCreator +0x10+0x00 = UniqueID2Keys (Dictionary<UniqueID, ContextDatabaseKey>): _entries at (dict+0x10+0x08 -> array)+0x20, stride 24, entry {hashCode:i32@0, next:i32@4, keyPtr@0x08, valuePtr@0x10}; the keyPtr is a UniqueID object whose _RowID Guid is at key+0x10 (16 bytes, .NET byte order), the valuePtr is the ContextDatabaseKey. ContextDatabaseKey +0x10+0x00 = KeyForSystem (i32 index). ContextDatabase +0x10+0x08 = Records (List<RecordInfo>): Records._items+0x20, [KeyForSystem]*8 -> RecordInfo. RecordInfo +0x10+0x08 = the ContextDatabaseRecord (its <Record> backing field). ContextDatabaseRecord +0x10+0x00 = Contexts (List of context objects): iterate _items, pick the element whose vtable == app.GatherContext's managed_vt (resolved live from TDB types[74683]+0x40). GatherContext BYTE +0x28: 0 = collected, 1 = available (verified by before/after gather diff AND by loading a save with the beetle alive -> flips back to 1). A beetle GUID absent from UniqueID2Keys just means never approached -> treat as uncollected.
